mentions.name: Robin (withrobin.dev)
mentions.description: An email automation assistant that handles recurring email chores such as managing calendar invites, publishing and sharing calendars, and acting as an email proxy so users don't have to give out their real address to services. It uses Cloudflare AI Gateway to bring AI into its functionality, is a work in progress, and has planned features including newsletter handling.
mentions.problem: Automating repetitive email chores and avoiding handing out one's real email address to various services.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://withrobin.dev

I've been automating many chores that i find myself usually doing with email: managing calendar invites, publishing and sharing calendars, but also want it to act like a proxy to avoid giving away my actual email in different services.
